title: The Square's Temporal Curvature  The Arithmetic Proof of Temporal Direction and Identity
description: This paper presents a formal arithmetic proof demonstrating that time is not a linear progression but a phase-driven geometric process governed by a 5x5 quadrant matrix. The author identifies a fundamental error in modern science: the assumption that (0+0) - (0+0) = 0 . By incorporating temporal directionality, this paper proves that the act of division (minus) within a phase shift from 0 to 1 generates a discrete value of 1, establishing the "Core Identity" (Eichbasis 5).
